questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

8 : 73 :: 9 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** **Number × (Number + 1) + 1**

 
• 8 : 73 → 8 × (8 + 1) + 1 = 8 × 9 + 1 = 72 + 1 = 73

Similarly,

 
• 9 : ? → 9 × (9 + 1) + 1 = 9 × 10 + 1 = 90 + 1 = 91

Hence, '**91**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five members, the Director, Producer, Script writer, Choreographer and Set designer, of a film production team are sitting in a row facing towards the north. The Director is sitting next to the Producer. The Script writer is sitting next to the Choreographer. The Choreographer is not sitting with the Set designer, who is at the left end of the row. The Script writer is at the second position from the right. The Director is to the right of the Producer and Set designer. The Director and Script writer are sitting together. In which of the following positions is the Director sitting?

options.text: Between the Scriptwriter and the Set designer
Between the Producer and the Scriptwriter
Between the Set designer and the Choreographer
Between the Producer and the Choreographer

questions.solution:
Five members, the **Director, Producer, Script writer, Choreographer and Set designer**, of a film production team are sitting in a row facing towards the north. 

1. The Choreographer is not sitting with the Set designer, who is at the left end of the row.

2. ​The Script writer is at the second position from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93dc359853fcce815f052d1117d23cecce86ba2d892b8b9ee69b143f4be0a167.png] 

3. The Script writer is sitting next to the Choreographer.

4. The Director is to the right of the Producer and Set designer. 

5. The Director is sitting next to the Producer.

6. The Director and Script writer are sitting together. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cff9099d1ea6895d6a4c3d4a789b228894f54f0277878f3575557f9d60e47300.png] 

Position in which the Director is sitting: 

 
• Between the Scriptwriter and the Set designer → Two persons Producer and Director are sitting between the Scriptwriter and the Set designer.
 
• Between the Producer and the Scriptwriter → **Director is sitting between the Producer and the Scriptwriter**.
 
• Between the Set designer and the Choreographer → Three persons Producer, Director and Scriptwriter are sitting between the Set designer and the Choreographer.
 
• Between the Producer and the Choreographer → Two persons Director and Scriptwriter are sitting between the Producer and the Choreographer.

Hence, '**option 2**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a festival sale, seven cars of different companies - A, B, C, D, E, F and G - are standing facing west. A is second to the left of B. B is third to the left of C. D is between F and B. C, which is fourth to the right of G, is at one end. Which of the following is the correct position of E?

options.text: Third to the left of B
Fourth to the left of A
Fifth to the right of G

questions.solution:
In a festival sale, seven cars of different companies - **A, B, C, D, E, F and G** - are standing facing west. 

1. C, which is fourth to the right of G, is at one end.

2. B is third to the left of C. 

3. D is between F and B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61d3c6d540cc3d38c9ab661a8399e9da6f7678e01e5223595a97ed29bdc06f79.png] 

4. A is second to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9500939f26a2e74d1e1a1ea09a250df83372f4019824b057cf314ab6952131.png] 

5. E, the only car left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f21629647db76fe67decebded1d92cab39bd6b6cb17f9d9f86eff58e4bc01509.png] 

 
• Third to the left of B → E is third to the left of B.
 
• Fourth to the left of A → There is no one fourth to the left of A.
 
• Second to right of C → There is no one second to right of C.
 
• Fifth to the right of G → There is no one fifth to the right of G.

Clearly, third to the left of B is the correct position of E.

Hence, '**Third to the left of B**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All woods are bottles.

All bottles are curtains.

Conclusions:

I. All curtains are bottles.

II. Some bottles are woods.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d91882f1d238033c9e6505d248a6a6ba846b36956658cac03d80e3d59b9a6a6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All curtains are bottles. → Do not follow (As, All bottles are curtains → Some curtains are bottles)

II. Some bottles are woods. → Follow (As, All woods are bottles)

Hence, **only conclusion II follows**.
